knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Cleaning removes visible soil from the outside. Reprocessing is a validated set of steps for re-use and is outside this course. Options 0 and 2 treat the two as the same activity.
Single-use devices must not be reused. Used items are left as found and escalated under the facility procedure. A wipe or return to stock is not an acceptable action.
Reprocessing authority is written and held by named staff. Seniority and verbal requests do not confer it. A partial wipe is still an unauthorised reprocessing step.

practicalCriteria: Given three request cards, the learner classifies each as reprocessing or outside role, and states the escalation step for each without starting any reprocessing step.
Given an item that appears to need reprocessing in a simulation, the learner leaves it as found, makes the area safe, and names the escalation contact.
The learner completes a record of a stopped request with item, location, requester, time and recipient.
passRule: Practical competence requires facility-observed assessment against the criteria above. A pass on the knowledge checks is not practical competence.
evidenceRequired: Signed classification sheet for three request cards
Observation note of the stop-and-escalate response in simulation
Completed record of a stopped reprocessing request
stopWorkCriteria: Learner performs any reprocessing, disinfection for re-use, sterilisation or internal cleaning of a reusable device
Learner returns a used single-use device to stock or reuses it
Learner moves an item that needs reprocessing to clean stock without escalation
